# Video script: Why hearts are missed

> DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Contains claims with status 'ai-extracted' that no clinician has verified.

Unit D0 | Target length: 4 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Presenter to camera | Fewer than half of heart anomalies are found before birth. Most of those babies had no risk factor. | IS23-004, IS23-080 |
| 2 | Graphic: two boxes, 'view not good enough' and 'abnormality not recognised' | When a diagnosis is missed, it is usually for one of two reasons. The view was not good enough. Or the view was good and nobody saw the problem. | IS23-088 |
| 3 | Diagram: four-chamber plane, then the planes above it lighting up | Four chambers are not enough. Transposition and coarctation can hide in that plane. The outflow tracts and the three-vessel views are where they show. | IS23-008, IS23-067 |
| 4 | Presenter | One sweep, the same way, every patient. Know normal so well that anything else stops you. And refer early. | - |
